title: Withdraw a Permit
goal: Withdraw an unstarted permit upon holder request to release the hall and maintain register accuracy

raw_statements: From the permit view, the officer can withdraw the permit.
A withdrawal reason is mandatory — free text, up to 500 characters.
The permit's status becomes WITHDRAWN and the reason is recorded in its history.
Withdrawal does not refund anything. Refunds are handled outside this system.
Obviously you can't withdraw a permit that has already started — the event is underway, the hall is occupied.
Only permits that haven't started yet can be withdrawn.
If it has started, that's a cancellation, and cancellations are a different process (not this release).
Payment itself — out of scope. Don't build a payment screen.

conflicts_and_resolutions.topic: Withdrawal Eligibility vs Event Start Date
conflicts_and_resolutions.story_rule: Permit can be withdrawn from permit view with no start date restriction.
conflicts_and_resolutions.clarification_rule: Permit CANNOT be withdrawn once event has started (startDate <= today). Only permits that have not started (startDate > today) are eligible.
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolved_precedence: Clarification (Ops Manager Jonathan Wee) supersedes generic story. Operational reality dictates occupied halls cannot be withdrawn.
conflicts_and_resolutions.action: Enforce BR-13: Reject withdrawal with 400 PERMIT_ALREADY_STARTED if startDate <= LocalDate.now().

conflicts_and_resolutions.story_rule: Withdrawal does not refund anything. Refunds handled outside.
conflicts_and_resolutions.clarification_rule: Payment itself is out of scope. No refund processing in this system.
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolved_precedence: Unanimous alignment between BA and Finance.
conflicts_and_resolutions.action: Zero database changes for refunds. Anti-invention check must reject any refund schema.

conflicts_and_resolutions.clarification_rule: Permit lifecycle has discrete terminal states (WITHDRAWN).
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolved_precedence: Permits already WITHDRAWN cannot be re-withdrawn.
conflicts_and_resolutions.action: Enforce BR-14: Reject withdrawal with 409 WRONG_STATUS if permit status is already WITHDRAWN.

functional_requirements.summary: Withdrawal action accessible from Permit Detail view
functional_requirements.description: Officer can initiate withdrawal from the read-only permit detail screen if eligible.
Withdrawal reason is mandatory, trimmed, non-blank, and max 500 characters.
Permit can only be withdrawn if startDate is strictly in the future (startDate > today). If event has started, return 400 PERMIT_ALREADY_STARTED.
Upon successful confirmation, permit status transitions to WITHDRAWN and updatedAt is updated.
Insert permit_history record with action='WITHDRAWN', detail=reason, performed_by='system', performed_at=now().
Permits already in WITHDRAWN status cannot be withdrawn again. Return 409 WRONG_STATUS.
